comparison.objective: Remove and store two transport keys before unloading a captive carrier; candidate adjusts and validates a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual rigid-pin removal, storage, and carrier unloading versus recessed-key insertion, fine collar rotation, counterholding, force-limited locking, and impact testing.
comparison.success_condition: Keys stored before carrier movement, with the carrier physically released and safely supported, versus two bounded dynamic stops and retained adjustment. Exact key/storage tolerances and separate spec versions were not provided.
comparison.reason: Both are robot-equipment service tasks with physical prerequisites, but transport-restraint release and dynamic commissioning test different abilities.
